plan.notes: Source: University of South Alabama official online catalog (bulletin.southalabama.edu — South Alabama's actual catalog domain) Computer Science (BS) page: https://bulletin.southalabama.edu/programs-az/computing/computer-science/computer-science-bs/ (catalog year 2026-2027), cross-checked against the School of Computing's official 2026-2027 CSC Undergraduate Check Sheet (https://usa50.southalabama.edu/colleges/soc/resources/csc-check-sheet-26-27.pdf). Transcription method: the catalog's official 'Graduation Plan — Plan of Study Grid (124 Total Hours)' names the required CSC/CIS/MA course for each term and leaves gen-ed/elective hours as unlabeled hour counts; those blank slots were filled as student-choice slots per the check sheet's requirement areas (History sequence, Literature, Art/Drama/Music, Fine Arts/Humanities elective, 2 Social Science electives, Natural Science sequence + 1 additional with lab, 2 approved Math minor electives, 4 CSC/CIS electives), never inventing specific courses. The check sheet itself states 'Semesters shown represent the norm but are NOT guaranteed' and 'Refer to the University Bulletin for Official Graduation Requirements.' Prerequisites transcribed from the bulletin's official course pages (minimum grade C unless noted): CSC 231 <- CSC 120; CSC 228 <- MA 125; MA 126 <- MA 125; CSC 311 <- CSC 231; CSC 320 <- CSC 228 + CSC 231; CSC 322 <- CSC 231; CSC 331 <- CSC 231 + CA 275 (CA 275 may be concurrent); CSC 333 <- CSC 231; CSC 399 <- CSC 322; CSC 434 <- CSC 333 (alt CSC 340, not in plan); CSC 440 <- CSC 331 + CSC 320 (may be concurrent; alt EE 264, not in plan); CIS 497 <- EH 372 + CSC 322 + CSC 333; CIS 498 <- CIS 497 (may be concurrent) + CSC 331. The bulletin lists NO prerequisite for CSC 332, CIS 101, or CIS 300, so none is recorded (not invented). Placement/assessment prerequisites are NOT course codes and live here, not in external_prereqs: MA 125 requires ACT Math 27 or MMT 090 or MA 113/MA 115 (C); CSC 120 requires ACT 27 or MMT 090 or MA 113/172/115/121/125/132 (C) — the official grid seats MA 125 in the same first term as CSC 120, consistent with placement-based entry; CSC 228 also accepts ACT 27 / MMT 090 / MA 113 or MA 115 (C), with in-plan MA 125 used as the recorded prereq. Catalog changes baked in: CSC 404 moved from required to elective effective Spring 2025; CSC 440 Secure Software Engineering is now a required core course. CIS 498 is a required 0-credit course (required_zero=true). Sequence rule: two courses in Social Sciences/Humanities must be a Literature or History sequence (satisfied by the HY choice slot).
